name: Woodworking Masters
old_description: At Wood Working Masters, we’re dedicated to redefining the art of woodworking with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and timeless craftsmanship. Founded on a passion for transforming raw materials into beautiful, functional works of art, our company stands at the forefront of custom woodworking and design.
about:
Woodworking Masters operates from Pacoima, California, a neighborhood in the San Fernando Valley of Los Angeles. The company was founded in 1996 as a family-owned woodworking shop, built on a passion for transforming raw lumber into functional works of art. The business is run by members of the Aguirre family, including Anthony, Leo, and Antonio Aguirre, who serve as primary contacts.

The shop produces custom architectural woodwork, including entry doors, staircases with balusters, and precision-engineered wood veneers. It also offers shop milling services for contractors and designers. Projects move from concept to completion using CAD software for design, followed by hand fabrication and a final inspection step. The facility handles a range of wood species, though specific equipment and headcount are not disclosed.

The customer base spans homeowners, general contractors, and interior designers throughout the Los Angeles area. Projects range from single custom doors to full staircase installations for residential and light commercial interiors.

The founders framed the venture as an art form rather than a trade, emphasizing craftsmanship, precision, and quality as guiding principles. The company positions its work as a blend of traditional hand skills and modern design tools, aiming to deliver timeless pieces that reflect the unique character of each wood species.
